subject: Mutual Action Plan + Pilot Milestones — Pinnacle HealthTech
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@pinnacle.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot & MAP next steps

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The execs are aligned on running a 6-week pilot focused on triage workflows. Can you send over a mutual action plan and a recommended evaluation schedule? The procurement team will need the renewal/commit asks early so we can include it in our quarter-end planning.

High level we want:
- 6-week pilot scope & success criteria
- Expected ramp and latency SLOs for production
- Pricing for pilot vs. production (including any pilot credits)

I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@pinnacle.ai) for timeline alignment. Aim to get the MAP to us by the end of next week if possible.

Thanks —
Alex
Head of Product, Pinnacle HealthTech
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@pinnacle.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot & MAP next steps

Alex —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (Pinnacle_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf) and a pricing summary (pricing_summary_v2.xlsx) that ties pilot milestones to a ramped commit. Key items:

- Pilot: 6 weeks (Mar 22 — Apr 30) focused on triage latency and safety checks.
- Success criteria: 90th pctl latency < 600ms, accuracy on labeled test set >= 86%, no P0 incidents during UAT.
- Post-pilot: Option for a 12-month commit with a 50k USD annual minimum. If Pinnacle signs within 30 days of pilot completion we can offer a conditional pilot-to-production credit and a discount tier.

To move forward I’m going to request a discount exception internally tied to the committed ARR and ramp schedule you’re targeting. Aditya — can you confirm the infra/SE support cadence for the pilot?

Goal: sign MAP and DocuSign by Apr 8 so procurement has time for review.

Attachments: Pinnacle_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf, pricing_summary_v2.xlsx

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Pinnacle MAP + discount ask (PIN-2027-034)

Team —

Pinnacle is ready to run the 6-week pilot and is open to a post-pilot 12-month commit with a 50k USD ARR minimum. To win this and lock timeline we are being asked for a pilot credit + an introductory discount on the committed rate.

Requesting guidance/approval:
- Discount requested by customer: 20% off list for year 1, contingent on signed 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot completion.
- Our recommendation: consider a 15% introductory discount with a $50k ARR commit and a 60-day payment term.

Why: The account is strategic in the health vertical, multi-product potential, and fast procurement timeline — they want a clear MAP with pricing built in.

Please advise who needs to sign off. I’ve attached the MAP and pricing summary for context. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/PIN-2027-034

Thanks —
Marcus
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Pinnacle MAP + discount ask (PIN-2027-034)

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. I support a path that balances competitiveness with unit economics. Proposed approval path:

1) VP sign-off (Evelyn) for a commercial exception up to 20% tied to a written MAP and specific ramp milestones.
2) CFO sign-off (Grace) for any discount >15% given financial impact and cash collection cadence.
3) Legal (Priyom) to confirm standard terms and any additional compliance language for the health vertical.

A couple of asks for the approvers:
- Expected ARR and 12-month ramp by quarter (please add to the finance worksheet).
- Clarify whether production usage will be isolated (required for HIPAA concerns) — Aditya please advise.

Once we have sign-off I’ll approve the commercial exception and Marcus can present the final MAP to Pinnacle.

-Lauren
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Pinnacle MAP + discount ask (PIN-2027-034)

Thanks for the context. I am willing to approve a VP-level commercial exception conditional on CFO sign-off and legal clearing the T&Cs. That said, I want clear ramp commitments before I sign anything:

- Target ARR Yr1: $50k committed, with expected ramp to $150k ARR by Q4 if integrations go well.
- Milestone linkage: 15% discount at signature; an additional 5% loyalty discount to be applied after 9 months if usage meets agreed thresholds.

Priyom — please review the MAP for any health-specific addenda. Grace — can you assess P&L impact and whether we need CEO escalation for anything beyond 15%?

Evelyn
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T15:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Pinnacle MAP + discount ask (PIN-2027-034)

Team —

Reviewed the numbers in finance_discount_workbook.xlsx. Quick answer: CFO can approve up to a 15% introductory discount for a $50k ARR commit given projected cash collection and expected CAC recovery. Any discount above 15% requires CEO sign-off because it materially reduces gross margin in year 1 for this cohort.

Conditions for CFO approval:
- Signed 12-month commitment and payment terms of net 30.
- Auto-rollback to list price if usage drops below 60% of the committed units for two consecutive months.
- Finance to receive final MAP and DocuSign link before signature.

I’m attaching the discount approval form for record (discount_approval_form.pdf). If Marcus can secure the 12-month signature window and include the rollback clause, finance will greenlight 15% immediately.

Grace O'Connor
CFO, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@pinnacle.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@pinnacle.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan + Pilot Milestones — Pinnacle HealthTech

Alex —

Thanks — we’ve aligned internally and can commit to the following offer if Pinnacle signs the 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot completion:

- Pilot: 6 weeks (Mar 22 — Apr 30) per MAP (attached).
- Commercial offer (post-pilot): 12-month commitment, $50k USD annual minimum.
- Discount: 15% introductory discount at signature (CFO-approved).
- Loyalty incentive: additional 5% discount after 9 months if committed usage thresholds are met (VP-level approval confirmed, applied retroactively).
- Conditions: Net 30 payment, rollback to list price if usage < 60% of committed units for two consecutive months.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached an updated MAP and the DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/Envelope/12345abcdef
2) Procurement — please review and confirm acceptance of the rollback clause and the payment term.
3) If acceptable, please return a signed DocuSign by 2027-04-08 to keep our MAP timeline intact.
